name: verify-iot-telemetry-edge-472
description: Computes LoRa time-on-air per spreading factor and turns a duty-cycle percentage into a daily message ceiling, for lesson 472's proof block. Zero dependencies and no network: it is arithmetic from published radio parameters, and the reader will quote these numbers in a design argument, so they have to be the run's numbers rather than the author's. Never installed as a dependency of the main app.
